question: List the names of readers with at least 10 loans and their number of loans.
gold: SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) FROM readers r JOIN loans l ON l.reader_id = r.reader_id GROUP BY r.reader_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
pred_sql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count FROM readers r JOIN loans l ON r.reader_id = l.reader_id GROUP BY r.reader_id, r.name HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 10
raw_output:
SELECT r.name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM readers r
JOIN loans l ON r.reader_id = l.reader_id
GROUP BY r.reader_id, r.name
HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 10;
